mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation o JOIN supplier_payment_operation b ON b.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND b.id=o.payment_id JOIN supplier_payment_returns f ON f.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND f.payment_id=o.payment_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.id=#{id} AND o.version=#{version} AND o.status='ADJUSTED' AND o.retired_version IS NULL AND o.completed_version IS NULL AND o.active_payment_id=o.payment_id AND o.command_json=#{stateJson} AND o.command_digest=#{digest} AND o.state_json=#{expectedStateJson} AND b.version=#{expectedVersion} AND b.state_json=#{stateJson8} AND b.command_json=#{commandJson} AND b.command_digest=#{commandDigest} AND b.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','REVERSED') AND f.version=#{version11} AND f.state_json=#{stateJson12}

SELECT c.*,o.state_json AS operation_json,b.state_json AS bank_json, prior.state_json AS before_json,afterward.state_json AS after_json FROM supplier_adjustment_completion c JOIN supplier_payable_adjustment_revision o ON o.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND o.operation_id=c.operation_id AND o.version=c.operation_version JOIN supplier_payment_revision b ON b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.operation_id=c.payment_id AND b.version=c.payment_version JOIN supplier_payment_returns_revision prior ON prior.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND prior.payment_id=c.payment_id AND prior.version=c.before_return_version JOIN supplier_payment_returns_revision afterward ON afterward.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND afterward.payment_id=c.payment_id AND afterward.version=c.return_version WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.operation_id=#{operationId}

SELECT c.*,o.state_json AS operation_json,b.state_json AS bank_json, prior.state_json AS before_json,afterward.state_json AS after_json FROM supplier_adjustment_completion c JOIN supplier_payable_adjustment_revision o ON o.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND o.operation_id=c.operation_id AND o.version=c.operation_version JOIN supplier_payment_revision b ON b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.operation_id=c.payment_id AND b.version=c.payment_version JOIN supplier_payment_returns_revision prior ON prior.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND prior.payment_id=c.payment_id AND prior.version=c.before_return_version JOIN supplier_payment_returns_revision afterward ON afterward.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND afterward.payment_id=c.payment_id AND afterward.version=c.return_version WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.payment_id=#{paymentId} ORDER BY c.return_version
